name: stock-research-agents
description: Run StockResearchAgents through any host and inspect the completed, auditable company dossier.

interface.longDescription: A credential-free, harness-neutral company and security research capability. The calling runtime owns reasoning, retrieval, entitlements, tools, authentication, and agent execution. StockResearchAgents owns exact-cutoff contracts, deterministic validation, durable stage boundaries, atomic publication, verified exports, and the completed-only Research Dossier Viewer.
defaultPrompt: Prepare evidence-first company research for a supported instrument, use a truthful live, fixture, or historical-replay mode, and show only the completed dossier.
Research a company as of an exact cutoff with caller-owned sources, explicit entitlement gaps, reproducible calculations, and no API keys in StockResearchAgents payloads.
Inspect a Completed Research Dossier with sources, claims, filings, peers, valuation, events, risks, monitoring, memory, and validation receipts.
